examples.arabic: بالتأكيد، فوجود الانسجام بين العمل والحياة الشخصية أمر ضروري، أليس كذلك؟
examples.english: Absolutely, for the existence of harmony between work and personal life is a necessary matter, is it not?
examples.transliteration: Bit-ta'keed, fa-wujood al-insijam bayna al-'amal wa al-hayah ash-shakhsiyyah amr darooree, alaysa kadhalik?
examples.storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

examples.arabic: فهم الناس في السوق هذا الاختلاف بين الاجيال دائما
examples.english: The people in the market always understood this difference between generations.
examples.transliteration: Fahima an-nas fi as-suqi hadha al-ikhtilaf bayna al-ajyal da'iman.

examples.arabic: هذه فروق واضحة بين الاجيال وكل جيل له عالمه الخاص
examples.english: These are clear differences between generations and each generation has its own world.
examples.transliteration: Hadhihi furooq waadihah bayna al-ajyaal wa-kull jeel lahu 'alamuhu al-khaas.

examples.english: The ideas are different between the mother and the son.
examples.transliteration: Al-afkar mukhtalifa bayna al-umm wa al-ibn.

examples.arabic: قضيت وقتا طويلا في التفكير بين بدلة زرقاء داكنة وثوب تقليدي مطرز باناقة
examples.english: I spent a long time deliberating between a dark blue suit and an elegantly embroidered traditional dress.
examples.transliteration: Qaḍaytu waqtan ṭawīlan fī at-tafkīr bayna badlah zarqā' dākinah wa thawb taqlīdī muṭarraz bi-anāqah.
examples.storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

examples.arabic: اليوم كانت هناك مباراة كرة قدم كبيرة بين فريقين مضحكين
examples.english: Today there was a big football match between two funny teams
examples.transliteration: Al-yawma kaanat hunaaka mubaraatu kurati qadamin kabeeratin bayna fareeqayni mudhikayni
